description: This file defines Bluetooth-related classes and functions for managing Bluetooth addresses, Extended Inquiry Response (EIR), key lists, and Bluetooth sockets (HCISocket and ManagementSocket) within the Thunder namespace. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and constants for Bluetooth management and socket operations.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth device address with utility methods for validation, string conversion, and NodeId generation.

classes.name: EIR
classes.description: Represents Extended Inquiry Response data, including device name, class, and UUIDs.

classes.name: KeyListType
classes.description: Template class managing lists of Bluetooth keys (e.g., LinkKey, LongTermKey).

classes.name: LinkKey
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth link key with validation and string conversion.

classes.name: LongTermKey
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth Long Term Key with validation and string conversion.

classes.name: IdentityKey
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth Identity Resolving Key with validation and string conversion.

classes.name: SignatureKey
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth Signature Resolving Key with validation and string conversion.

classes.name: HCISocket
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth HCI socket operations, including scanning, inquiry, advertising, and command execution.

classes.name: ManagementSocket
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth management interface operations, device info retrieval, and configuration.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Parses buffer data into EIR object, extracting device name, class, and UUIDs.

methods.name: Discoverable
methods.description: Sets discoverable mode with optional limited mode and duration.

methods.name: AddUUID
methods.description: Adds a UUID to the device.

methods.name: RemoveUUID
methods.description: Removes a UUID from the device.

methods.name: AddDevice
methods.description: Adds a device to the kernel's Bluetooth device list.

methods.name: RemoveDevice
methods.description: Removes a device from the kernel's Bluetooth device list.

methods.name: Pair
methods.description: Initiates pairing with a remote device.

methods.name: Unpair
methods.description: Removes pairing with a remote device.

methods.name: UserPINCodeReply
methods.description: Replies with a PIN code during pairing.

methods.name: UserPasskeyReply
methods.description: Replies with a passkey during pairing.
